entries.title: Psalms 20:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee; {defend...: Heb. set thee on an high place}

words.text: thee; {defend...: Heb. set thee on an high place}

entries.title: Psalms 20:2
segments: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion; {thee help: Heb. thy help} {strengthen: Heb. support}

words.text: ; {thee help: Heb. thy help} {strengthen: Heb. support}

entries.title: Psalms 20:3
segments: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah. {accept: Heb. turn to ashes: or, make fat}

words.text: . {accept: Heb. turn to ashes: or, make fat}

entries.title: Psalms 20:4
segments: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

words.text: thee according to thine own heart

entries.title: Psalms 20:5
segments: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up [our] banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

entries.title: Psalms 20:6
segments: ¶Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand. {his holy...: Heb. the heaven of his holiness} {with...: Heb. by the strength of the salvation of}

words.text: . {his holy...: Heb. the heaven of his holiness} {with...: Heb. by the strength of the salvation of}

entries.title: Psalms 20:7
segments: Some [trust] in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

entries.title: Psalms 20:8
segments: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

entries.title: Psalms 20:9
segments: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
